avoid_supplements.name: Dideoxynucleosides (DDI, DDC)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive mitochondrial toxicity and increased risk of pancreatitis, peripheral neuropathy, and hepatic steatosis
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated in combination; avoid all co-administration

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin B12 (>1000 mcg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase stavudine phosphorylation and mitochondrial toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Limit supplemental B12 to ≤1000 mcg daily; monitor for neuropathy

caution_supplements.name: Carnitine
caution_supplements.mechanism: Stavudine-induced carnitine depletion may increase mitochondrial dysfunction; supplementation may be protective
caution_supplements.action: Monitor carnitine levels; consider supplementation if deficiency develops (usual dose 2-3g daily)

caution_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May provide hepatoprotection against stavudine-associated hepatic steatosis
caution_supplements.action: May consider as adjunctive support; ensure no drug-drug interactions with other antiretrovirals

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slow stavudine absorption and delay peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Administer stavudine on empty stomach (30 minutes before or 2 hours after food) for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases hepatotoxicity risk and mitochondrial dysfunction; may worsen stavudine-associated fatty liver disease
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; counsel patient on hepatic toxicity risk

monitoring_notes: Stavudine is rarely used in modern ART regimens due to significant mitochondrial toxicity and lipodystrophy risks. Monitor for peripheral neuropathy, pancreatitis, hepatic steatosis, and lactate accumulation; baseline and periodic CD4, viral load, liver/renal function, and lactate levels are essential.
